oled_ssd1306_spi.description: Bit-banged SPI (500 kHz, mode 0, MSB first) SSD1306 driver: VDD on, 1 ms wait, VBAT on, 1 ms wait, RES pulse, 25-command init list, then 512-byte display RAM fill with alternating 0xAA/0x55 stripes; led lights on done.

pmod_loopback.description: Drives test patterns out of Pmod JA, samples Pmod JB after a 1 ms settle, compares. Requires eight jumper wires JA to JB pin for pin. Patterns: walking 1 (x2), walking 0 (x2), 0x55, 0xAA, incrementing counter. led[0] pass so far, led[1] error latched, led[7:2] mismatch count.

vga_640x480.description: 640x480 at 60 Hz from 100 MHz GCLK with divide-by-4 pixel clock enable (25 MHz). H total 800 (640+16+96+48), V total 525 (480+10+2+33), sync active low. Eight vertical color bars plus white border frame; led toggles once per frame.
